text:
marina: Heads-up — opened a migration guide PR for the batching_hint config. Trying to clarify the default behavior and update SDK examples before we merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452

devin: nice, link works for me. what's the exact question about defaults?

marina: docs currently say default is 'auto' and show code with batching_hint: 'auto' in examples. But SDK snippets omit the field (rely on runtime default). I need confirm: is runtime default 'auto' everywhere, or different on Dedicated/Private?

ken: SDK owner here — we intentionally omit batching_hint in the SDK when it's the default. If runtime default is 'auto', the JS/py examples should either omit it or explicitly say "omit to use default". Adding 'batching_hint: "auto"' is technically ok but may be misleading for Dedicated users.

devin: runtime: default is 'auto' on Hosted and Private control plane, but Dedicated clusters with strict isolation run in 'manual' mode unless the pool is configured for adaptive batching. So default is environment-dependent.

aya: that environment nuance is important for the migration guide — customers will hit different behavior when migrating a job from hosted to a reserved Dedicated pool.

marina: ugh — that's the blocker. PR preview currently generates an SDK snippet that shows batching_hint set to 'auto'. CI/docs preview: please check the screenshots.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #452 (marina). Preview URL: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/452

ci-bot: linkcheck: ERROR — found internal link to http://internal.redwood/docs/batching-config in migration guide (blocked).

marina: ack, I'll replace that link with the public spec. But still need runtime wording. Should we: (A) show examples that omit the field and add a note about environment defaults, or (B) show explicit values per environment?

ken: I'd prefer (A) — examples that omit the field, plus a small callout: "Hosted/Private default to 'auto'; Dedicated may default to 'manual' unless configured." Then include a code comment showing how to force a specific hint. Keeps SDK examples aligned with current SDK behavior.

samir: for merge timing — reviewer rota has aya and devin this week. Aya is OOO tomorrow afternoon. If we need runtime signoff we might have to wait until Monday unless devin can confirm now.

devin: I can confirm the note above. But two clarifications: 1) is there an explicit API field name? it's batching_hint or batching.mode? 2) SDK currently maps parameter name "batching_hint" in JS and python, right?

ken: yes to JS/py param name: batching_hint. On the server it's batching.mode in internal config, but API surface is batching_hint.

marina: perfect. I'll change the examples to omit the field, add the environment note, and add an explicit snippet for forcing the value. Something like:

ken: "JS snippet:

await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-medium',
  // omit batching_hint to use runtime default
  prompt: 'Summarize...'
})

// Force manual batching:
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', batching_hint: 'manual', prompt: '...' })"

aya: that wording sounds good. Also suggest a short sentence about Dedicated pool config: "Dedicated admins can enable adaptive batching per pool; consult Dedicated admin guide."

marina: will add that and swap the internal link for the public one.

ci-bot: docs-preview: rebuild scheduled after push by marina.

ci-bot: linkcheck: OK (after update) — however, accessibility check warns: code block lacks language tag for the JS snippet.

marina: fixed — added ```js fence. Pushed.

ci-bot: preview updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/452 (new)

samir: reviewer ping — @aya @devin can you take a final look? if both approve we can slot this for the Tuesday merge window at 10:00 PT.

aya: quick pass done, comments left on wording. overall LGTM. :thumbsup:

devin: LGTM for runtime accuracy. small nit in wording but not a blocker. :eyes:

marina: thanks all — will address aya's wording nit and then request merge. If devops needs the merge window I'll file the slot.

ken: one more note: add a line in the SDK docs noting that the SDK omits batching_hint by default to follow runtime defaults — prevents copy-paste confusion.

marina: added that line. Ready to request merge after you two approve final wording.

docs-bot: PR #452 status: awaiting approvals (1/2).

marina: tagging this for devex review too in case examples need formatting: @ken @samir

samir: will coordinate merge window with release calendar once approvals are in.

marina: thanks everyone — reducing this from a blocker to 'waiting on final approvals and merge slot'. Will follow up in the morning if anything changes."
